question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**Fly off the handle**
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "To become suddenly angry". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Fly off the handle"** refers to someone losing their temper or becoming suddenly angry without warning. (अचानक गुस्सा होना) • **Example:** He flew off the handle when he realized someone had scratched his car. • The correct meaning of the idiom is "to become suddenly angry" and is commonly used in situations where someone reacts emotionally or angrily to a situation. (अचानक गुस्से में प्रतिक्रिया देना) • **Example:** She tends to fly off the handle whenever someone criticizes her work. • Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To escape quietly** (चुपचाप भाग जाना): Refers to sneaking away or leaving a place without attracting attention. • **Example:** He managed to escape quietly before the guards noticed him. • **Option 2: To disappear quickly** (जल्दी से गायब हो जाना): Refers to vanishing or going out of sight within a short period. • **Example:** The magician made the coin disappear quickly during his performance. • **Option 4: To handle a situation smartly** (स्मार्ट तरीके से स्थिति को संभालना): Refers to dealing with or managing a situation efficiently and wisely. • **Example:** She handled the crisis smartly and calmed everyone down. 35:T960, The correct answer is: **Uninformed**.
